name: ipv4_code
turns: Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a valid IPv4 address. Then explain how it works and show two example calls. About 300 words in total.

name: lighthouse_story
turns: Write a short story, about 330 words, about a lighthouse keeper named Elsie who finds a message in a bottle.

name: train_problem
turns: A train leaves Leeds at 9:40 and travels at an average of 60 mph. A second train leaves the same station at 10:10 on the same route at 75 mph. When and how far from Leeds does the second train catch up? Show your working step by step, in about 250 words.
